code: knitr::kable(dbh_parameters, digits = 1,              col.names = c("Species", "DBH class", "Intercept", "Slope", "Loading")) library(tidyverse)  plots <- read_csv("data/plots.csv") |>   select(plot_id, stand_id, easting, northing, area, p95, x)  prediction <- read_csv("data/prediction.csv") |>   select(plot_id, stand_id, easting, northing, area, p95, x)  locations <- bind_rows(   plots |> mutate(dataset = "plot"),   prediction |> mutate(dataset = "prediction") ) |>   mutate(easting_km = easting / 1000, northing_km = northing / 1000) beta_0 <- log(350) beta_1 <- -0.2 size <- 50 phi_w <- 3  species <- c("pine", "oak", "birch") dbh_classes <- c("10-20", "20-30", "30-40", "40-50", "50+") alpha_pine <- c(intercept = 0, slope = 0.5) alpha_oak <- c(intercept = -0.5, slope = -0.5)  # Each row describes one DBH allocation step within one species. dbh_parameters <- tibble(   species = rep(species, each = 4),   dbh_class = rep(dbh_classes[1:4], times = 3),   intercept = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5,                 -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1,                  0, 0.5, 1, 1.5),   slope = c(-0.4, -0.3, -0.2, -0.1,             -0.3, -0.3, -0.2, -0.2,             -0.2, -0.2, -0.1, -0.1),   loading = c(0.7, 0.5, 0.3, 0.1,              -0.5, -0.4, -0.3, -0.2,               0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1) ) # One unit-variance field shared by all species and DBH allocation steps. coordinates <- as.matrix(select(locations, easting_km, northing_km)) distance <- as.matrix(dist(coordinates))  set.seed(1)  locations$w <- drop(t(chol(exp(-phi_w * distance))) %*%                       rnorm(nrow(locations)))  rm(distance) # Magnitude and species allocation depend on canopy height alone. locations <- locations |>   mutate(     expected_density = exp(beta_0 + beta_1 * x),     count = rnbinom(n(), mu = area * expected_density, size = size)   )  pi_pine <- pnorm(alpha_pine[1] + alpha_pine[2] * locations$x) pi_oak <- pnorm(alpha_oak[1] + alpha_oak[2] * locations$x)  species_counts <- tibble(   pine = rbinom(nrow(locations), locations$count, pi_pine) )  species_counts$oak <- rbinom(   nrow(locations), locations$count - species_counts$pine, pi_oak )  species_counts$birch <- locations$count - rowSums(species_counts) categories <- expand_grid(species = species, dbh_class = dbh_classes) |>   mutate(category = paste(species, dbh_class, sep = ":"))  counts <- matrix(0L, nrow = nrow(locations), ncol = nrow(categories),                  dimnames = list(NULL, categories$category))  for (s in species) {   coefficients <- dbh_parameters |> filter(species == s)   remaining <- species_counts[[s]]    for (b in 1:4) {     probability <- pnorm(coefficients$intercept[b] +                           coefficients$slope[b] * locations$x +                           coefficients$loading[b] * locations$w)     category <- paste(s, dbh_classes[b], sep = ":")     counts[, category] <- rbinom(nrow(locations), remaining, probability)     remaining <- remaining - counts[, category]   }    counts[, paste(s, "50+", sep = ":")] <- remaining }

counts[, category]   }    counts[, paste(s, "50+", sep = ":")] <- remaining }  locations <- bind_cols(locations, as_tibble(counts)) plots <- locations |>   filter(dataset == "plot") |>   select(-dataset, -delta_0, -delta_1, -u_0, -u_1)  prediction <- locations |>   filter(dataset == "prediction") |>   select(-dataset, -delta_0, -delta_1, -u_0, -u_1)
